title: MSSQL_PID not set: the container runs Developer edition
Developer edition in a production file
source: Microsoft: Developer editions are licensed for use as a development and test system, not as a production server

title: Evaluation edition expires
source: Microsoft: an evaluation deployment is available for 180 days

title: Web edition is hosting only
source: Microsoft SQL Server 2022 pricing: Web = Hosting only; not in the SQL Server 2025 MSSQL_PID table

title: Legacy Enterprise (Server + CAL) PID
source: Microsoft: Enterprise PID is limited to 20 cores per instance and isn't available for new agreements; choose EnterpriseCore

title: SQL Server product key committed to the repository
source: Microsoft: a product key has the form #####-#####-#####-#####-#####

title: Fewer than 4 cores still costs 4 core licences
source: SQL Server licensing: minimum of four core licences per virtual OSE (VM or container)

title: Paid edition with no CPU limit
source: Microsoft SQL Server 2022 pricing: license all the virtual cores on the virtual OSE

title: Standard edition cannot use these cores
source: Microsoft: Standard is limited to lesser of 4 sockets or 32 cores (2025); 24 cores in SQL Server 2022 and earlier

title: Express edition cannot use these cores
source: Microsoft: Express is limited to lesser of 1 socket or 4 cores, 1,410 MB buffer pool, 50 GB database (2025)

title: ACCEPT_EULA missing
source: Microsoft: ACCEPT_EULA is a required setting for the SQL Server image

title: Image tag not pinned to a SQL Server version
source: Edition limits and MSSQL_PID values differ between SQL Server 2022 and 2025

title: StandardDeveloper / EnterpriseDeveloper on a pre-2025 image
source: Microsoft: StandardDeveloper and EnterpriseDeveloper are listed in the SQL Server 2025 MSSQL_PID table only
